name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 2: windows used for selection are never used for validation (Phase 4 step 6)
adds_to: bl010_criteria.json - unchanged; this file only adds a rule that file does not have
rule: Committed before Phase 5 runs. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Finding F10: Round 4's Steady Winner test required blocks that had already been selection filters, so the validation could only agree with the selection. criteria.check_windows enforces this rule in code.

windows.rule: A date range that decides which configs go forward (a selection filter) may not overlap a date range that judges them (a validation block). A config chosen on data ending at D is validated only on data after D, or by a walk-forward that re-selects using data before each test year with the embargo below.

holdout.use: Phase 6 only, once, on the frozen choice. No strategy backtest may read it before then.
